label: followup
scope: Two bounded observations, not a sustained monitor. Local HTTP API, retained heartbeat bytes, pure read-only supervisor helper and OS process metadata only; no direct broker API, starts/stops, model execution, project or vault writes.

supervisor.scope: Fresh supervisor-reported process and output checks; not an independent OS process inventory or forecast-performance assessment.

os_processes.scope: Canonical-project script paths, executable identity, PID, parent PID and creation UTC only. Raw command lines, account identifiers and credential arguments are not retained.

privacy: No account identifiers, secrets, raw account snapshots or complete HTTP payload are retained. The full-API SHA is ingestion provenance only and cannot be replayed from this compact record.
